Good morning, and welcome to Miami. A few things before the doors open. If you have not checked in yet, the registration desk is at the Hall A entrance, and it closes at eight thirty. Please have your QR code ready. It is in your confirmation email and in the conference app. The app is also the fastest way to get your bearings. It has the floor plan, the full agenda and the four tracks: payments, digital assets, regulation and small business. Shuttles to the partner hotels leave every twenty minutes from the south entrance, and the last one tonight is at eleven. The networking lounge on the second floor is open all day, with coffee and quiet tables for meetings. And one last reminder. The side events this evening are by invitation only, so please check the app for your invitations before six. Have a great first day.

Oh, this is my third time here, so I know the feeling. The first year, I spent the whole morning walking in circles. Now I do it differently. I've been here since seven, and I've been sitting in the networking lounge most of the time, because that is where people actually stop and talk. My advice? Do not make the rounds of the booths before lunch. In the morning everybody is fresh and busy, and the vendors are only interested in the big names. After lunch, they have been standing for five hours, and they are happy to talk to anybody. And go to the side events in the evening. That is where the real conversations start.

Sorry, I've got about two minutes. I've been running between sessions all morning. I'm on the regulation track. I work in compliance, for a bank in Charlotte. Latin America? Yes, actually, that's interesting. We've been looking at Brazil for about a year, mostly because of instant payments. Our problem is not the technology. It's knowing who is on the other side of the payment. Look, I have to go, my panel starts at eleven. Here's my card. Send me an email today, not next week. And put the word Brazil in the subject line, otherwise it gets lost with the other two hundred emails from this conference.
